- **Video restoration and Smooth motion on Frameleaf Cloud work again (FL-1725):** sending a video to Frameleaf Cloud for restoration or Smooth motion was refused every time. It now goes through. Rotated phone videos, trimmed clips, clips with a changing frame rate and camcorder files are prepared so they come back right, with the sound in step. If Frameleaf Cloud can't do what you picked (4× restoration, or a Smooth motion speed above 120 frames a second), you're told before anything is sent or charged, with the setting that would work.
- **Desktop helpers (FL-1715):** a desktop that keeps failing on a model stops getting that work sooner, a desktop you pause or close no longer counts as failing, and work handed back by a desktop goes straight to another one.
- **Follow and download from more sites (FL-1731):** subreddits, RedGIFs, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr, Vimeo, Twitch, Imgur, Flickr and DeviantArt.
- **Browser extension 1.2.0 (FL-1729):** keyboard shortcuts, a toolbar badge, right-click Save link and Save selection, and the toolbar opens on video, channel, account and post pages.
- **Folder albums (FL-838):** turn folder albums on or off from the web, see a preview before you do, and spot folder albums by their badge.
- **iCloud (sync fixes):** a sync that fails no longer stays stuck. Faster iCloud downloads (FL-1724, up to 100 at a time) move to the next release: the setting already accepts 1 to 100, and this release downloads at most 4 at a time.
- **Fixes (FL-1726, FL-1727, FL-1721, FL-1722):** landmark cards no longer repeat the same photo, workflow filters show their options properly, and Manager can verify a release built on Frameleaf's own build servers.
- **Save to Frameleaf 1.2.0 (FL-1729):** keyboard shortcuts open the extension (⌥⇧F or Alt+Shift+F), take a screenshot (⌥⇧S) and save the page as a link (⌥⇧L); change them on your browser's shortcuts page from the extension's Settings. The toolbar button shows how many items are waiting, or "!" when one needs you. Right-click a link to save it without opening it, or select text and right-click to save the page with that text as its note. Connecting to a server on your home network over plain http now works when “Allow a local server without HTTPS” is on.
- **Follow and download from more sites (FL-1731):** subreddits, RedGIFs, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr, Vimeo, Twitch, Imgur, Flickr and DeviantArt are recognised. Paste or open a profile, channel or blog to follow it, or a single post, video, clip, image or album to download it. A Twitch channel saves its past broadcasts.
